status: authored 2026-10-09 as one of the walk-through halls (docs/world-building/GYM_WALKTHROUGH.md); offline checks only (tools/gym_arenas.py check, tools/gym_arenas_audit.py, tools/gym_trainers.py check). Nothing of it has been built in a world or seen in a running game.
name: The Hall of Lenses
reading: Sabrina's town is the region's place of study (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym6_town: it records what the Rift does to memory and perception; calcite, smooth quartz, polished diorite, purpur and an end-rod's light as accents) and she is its Rift researcher. One building at the head of the white axis, walked through: in at the south door on the axis into the reading stacks, a long foyer of shelving along a divider wall with three eye-arches, only the east one -- the one under the Eye -- going through; up the turret's four-step stair into the lens chamber, with three apertures in its west wall, only the middle one open; and out through it onto the terrace at the east end of the Observation Well, the tallest room of the eight (22 courses clear), turned upward: a great biconvex lens of tinted glass in a purpur rim hangs on four chains from the ceiling, its image let into the floor as a purpur ring round the two Pokemon marks. A broad stair of four takes the player down into the Well, the leader small at the far end on a four-course purpur dais under THE EYE, the town's sign (purpur lid, quartz white, froglight pupil), lit from behind her. Out past her by the iron door in the Well's south wall, or back the way you came.

challenge_spawner.why: gym_arenas.check asks every leader outside single_leader.rollout to name the Challenge cell it takes out, hall or not. A hall's takedown (gym6_takedown) fills the whole carved arena, this cell included, back to stone, so nothing is restored by a move; data/challenge_mode.json bosses.kanto_sabrina.spawner.at is now (6181, 101, 3312) in this hall's dais.

replaces.why: what stood before this hall and is taken down by it, measured from the records that built it. The arena is data/gym_arenas/gym6.json as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (schema gym_arena/1, git history); the building is data/gym_buildings/gym6.json, kept, now superseded_by this file. Below the lot the takedown (gym6_takedown) fills the arena's bounds and the last two courses of its descent with stone; above it this hall's first part clears the lot.

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (a Cobbleverse dependency, already installed), set as GYM_ARENAS.md sets them: one under the floor's top course so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon on the floor; the trainer stand under the dais top one in front of the seat. Sabrina's clear radius is 2.09 (slowbro's model sweep) and her tallest is hatterene at 6.13: her Pokemon stands 5.50 from the dais face (3.41 to spare) and the nearest solid within eight courses of either block is 5.50 (trainer) and 8.86 (challenger), measured from the built model. The two are 4 apart (the widest hitbox is 1.53, exeggutor), the challenger's 3 behind its own at the stand. The lens's lowest course is y77, ten over the floor against hatterene's 6.13, and the check's own ceiling is y74.

arena.why: the carved arena as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (data/gym_arenas/gym6.json, schema gym_arena/1, git history before the walk-through): 40 by 32 by 26, floor y66, the dais at its west end (seat (6181, 70, 3320)), reached by a newel stair from the lens chamber

entry.why: street is the cell on the town's axis just south of the lot, in front of the door (ground y96 at x6196, z3335, tools/ground.py rounded: the lot is levelled to y97, so the axis steps up one onto the pad). entry.floor is the Well's first cell inside the aperture, on the terrace at the east end: 19.0 from Sabrina (3D to her stand at (6183, 102, 3312)), farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1 = 17, so the player stands in the room, up on the terrace, before she can call the fight.

exit.why: the door past the leader: an iron door in the Well's south wall into the west reading cell (and from it, through the west arch, the foyer and the door on the axis), opened by the stone button on the wall beside it, inside the Well. Nothing outside opens it, so it cannot be used to reach Sabrina past the stacks and the lens chamber and their juniors. Or back the way you came: the stair and the chamber are walked both ways.

blocks_why: the town's palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym6_town: calcite, smooth quartz, polished diorite, purpur) and nothing that is a spawn condition (no grass, leaves, water, sand, carpet, concrete, and no amethyst or quartz block, which data/spawn_blocks.json lists); the froglight is the town's own lamp. No amethyst and no end rod: tools/gym_trainers.py's movement model has no row for either, and the gyms' authors do not edit it.
